$comment: The AI apps Surehand MCP connects to: one list for the server (names), the Windows Setup's Choose AI apps page and the Mac Installer's Installation Type choices (installer/ai-apps.mjs), in this order. id: the server's client id (surehand-ae connect <id>). mac: where the Mac Installer looks for the app (~ is the home folder): the app itself or its command line, never a data folder (~/.lmstudio, ~/.cursor, Application Support/Claude...), which stays behind when the app is uninstalled; Claude Code, which has no app, also by ~/.claude.json. macName / web.macTitle: a shorter name for the Mac Installer's Custom Install list, whose Package Name column cuts titles off at about 30 characters (the description under the list says the rest); the server's own test (server/src/cli/clients.ts clientInstalled) follows the same rule and is what Windows uses. web: ChatGPT on the web, which needs cloudflared (optional, never ticked by default).
